cues.en: In this video, I'm going to discuss indefinite and definite integrals now, of course, integration is a huge topic in calculus.
cues.zh: 這段要談不定積分與定積分；當然，積分是微積分裡很大的主題。

cues.en: In many college programs, you would spend an entire semester just talking about integration.
cues.zh: 許多大學課程，會花整學期只談積分。

cues.en: And I'm basically going to summarize it all in about three minutes.
cues.zh: 我基本上要在三分鐘左右概括全部。

cues.en: So let's see how I do.
cues.zh: 看看表現如何。

cues.en: I'm going to introduce you to the concept of an integral, which is actually pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 先介紹積分概念，其實很直接。

cues.en: You're just adding together a lot of really tiny little things.
cues.zh: 就是把很多非常微小的東西加起來。

cues.en: And then I'll show you definite and indefinite integration, obviously, how to implement and compute integrals in Python.
cues.zh: 再示範定積分與不定積分，當然，還有如何在Python實作和計算積分。

cues.en: And then in the exercise, you will also see how the indefinite integral is related to the derivative.
cues.zh: 練習裡，也會看到不定積分和導數的關係。

cues.en: And you'll see that it's basically like the inverse of the derivative.
cues.zh: 會看到，它基本上像是求導的反運算。

cues.en: So here I have a function.
cues.zh: 這裡有個函數。

cues.en: It's just some function that goes up and then down and up again.
cues.zh: 就是某個先上升、再下降、再上升的函數。

cues.en: And now a question is what is the area between these two lines?
cues.zh: 現在的問題，是這兩條線之間的面積多少？

cues.en: So if you would take the area that fills in all of these boundaries here, so at the bottom of the axis
cues.zh: 假如取這些邊界包住的面積，下面是座標軸，

cues.en: and then these two sides and then the curve here, this function here defines the top of the boundary.
cues.zh: 還有這兩側，上面則由這條曲線、這個函數界定。

cues.en: How would you go about identifying this area of this space here?
cues.zh: 怎麼找出這塊空間的面積？

cues.en: Well, one way you could do it is by putting a bunch of bars that would fill in, roughly fill in this area.
cues.zh: 一種做法，是放進很多長條，大致填滿這個區域。

cues.en: And then you count the area of all of the bars and you say, well, that's a pretty decent approximation of the area of this surface.
cues.zh: 再計算全部長條的面積，就能說，這大致是不錯的面積近似。

cues.en: So how do you compute the area of all of these bars?
cues.zh: 這些長條的面積怎麼算？

cues.en: Well, we start with this one bar or rectangle.
cues.zh: 先從一個長條，也就是長方形開始。

cues.en: The area of a rectangle is the height times the width.
cues.zh: 長方形面積是高乘寬。

cues.en: So the height here looks like one, two, three, four, five.
cues.zh: 這裡高度看起來是1、2、3、4、5。

cues.en: Let's just call that five.
cues.zh: 就算5。

cues.en: And what is the width here?
cues.zh: 寬度多少？

cues.en: Well, three of these bars fits into one unit here.
cues.zh: 這裡一個單位，能放三個長條。

cues.en: So this is one third across here and it's five units up here.
cues.zh: 所以寬三分之一，高5個單位。

cues.en: So five times one third is, of course, five third's.
cues.zh: 5乘三分之一，當然是三分之五。

cues.en: So this area here is five third's.
cues.zh: 這裡的面積是三分之五。

cues.en: And then you would have to compute this area in this area and so on, and then some of these up together.
cues.zh: 再計算這塊、這塊，依此類推，再把它們加起來。

cues.en: Now, of course, that's not going to give you an exact correct answer, and that's because you can see these bars.
cues.zh: 當然，不會得到精確答案，因為看這些長條。

cues.en: So this one, you know, overshoots a little bit and we're missing.
cues.zh: 這一個稍微超出去，還少了，

cues.en: There's a gap over here.
cues.zh: 這裡這個空隙。

cues.en: So what can we do about that?
cues.zh: 怎麼辦？

cues.en: We could follow this same approach, but make these bars a little bit thinner.
cues.zh: 可以沿用相同方法，但把長條變細一點。

cues.en: So we still cut up this area into a bunch of vertical bars and counter areas or some other areas, but we make the bars thinner.
cues.zh: 同樣把區域切成許多垂直長條，計算、加總面積，只是讓長條更細。

cues.en: Now, you can imagine that the thinner these bars get, the more accurate this estimate of the area is going to get.
cues.zh: 可以想像，長條愈細，這個面積估計愈精確。

cues.en: And then we basically get down to an infinitesimal, which means the smallest possible width that a bar can possibly take.
cues.zh: 最後基本上到無窮小，也就是長條所能具有的最小寬度。

cues.en: Now, on my computer screen, that width would be one pixel.
cues.zh: 在我的電腦螢幕上，那寬度會是一個像素。

cues.en: But out there in the continuous analog real world, the width of that is going to be, you know, I guess it's like Planck length, the sort of smallest discontinuation of the physical universe.
cues.zh: 但在外面連續、類比的現實世界，寬度大概像普朗克長度，就是物理宇宙最小的離散單位。

cues.en: OK, so but that is the principle.
cues.zh: 不過原理就是這樣。

cues.en: We basically sum up a lot of really thin bars that cover the function from this boundary point to this boundary point.
cues.zh: 把許多非常細的長條加起來，覆蓋這個邊界點到那個邊界點之間的函數區域。

cues.en: And that leads to the notation for computing the integral.
cues.zh: 這就導向計算積分的記號。

cues.en: You have this really long thing.
cues.zh: 這個很長的東西。

cues.en: It kind of looks like the little piece that's cut out of a violin, but it's called an integral symbol.
cues.zh: 有點像小提琴上挖出的那個形狀，但它叫積分符號。

cues.en: And you can think of it like an S.
cues.zh: 可以把它想成S。

cues.en: It's like you're taking S for summation, but then you're squeezing the S a little bit and stretching it.
cues.zh: 像把代表加總summation的S，稍微擠窄再拉長。

cues.en: So it's really tall.
cues.zh: 讓它很高。

cues.en: So this symbol means to integrate between A and B, and that's drawn here.
cues.zh: 這個符號表示在a到b之間積分，圖上也畫出來。

cues.en: So A is this boundary and B would be this boundary here.
cues.zh: a是這個邊界，b是那個邊界。

cues.en: And then the way to interpret this here is this is the function.
cues.zh: 這裡的解讀方式，是這個是函數。

cues.en: So this is actually the height of the bar at each point in X and D, X is like the smallest, thinnest
cues.zh: 也就是每個x位置的長條高度，而dx像是最微小、最細的，

cues.en: width of the discrimination of X.
cues.zh: x離散化寬度。

cues.en: So you can see this is really just the height of the bar times, the width of the bar, and then this gets smaller and smaller until it goes towards zero or infinitesimal and this ends up being just the
cues.zh: 所以實際上就是長條高乘寬，再讓這個愈來愈小，趨近0或無窮小，最後就成了，

cues.en: function itself.
cues.zh: 函數本身。

cues.en: Now this is called a definite integral, and that's because we are definitely computing an area between
cues.zh: 這叫定積分，因為我們確實要計算，

cues.en: the definite points, A and B, if you just want the general formula of what the integration of some
cues.zh: 明確的a、b兩點之間的面積；如果只想知道某個，

cues.en: function would look like, then you don't actually need these boundaries here A and B, instead, you want to compute what's called the indefinite integral.
cues.zh: 函數積分後的一般公式，就不需要a和b這些邊界，而是計算所謂不定積分。

cues.en: Now this is where your calculus course starts getting really hairy because computing indefinite integrals is not so straightforward.
cues.zh: 微積分課到這裡就開始棘手，因為不定積分沒那麼容易算。

cues.en: You have to learn a lot of tricky.
cues.zh: 要學很多技巧。

cues.en: You have to look up integration tables and so on, but it actually turns out that some functions are pretty straightforward to integrate, including Polynomial.
cues.zh: 要查積分表等，不過有些函數其實很容易積分，包括多項式。

cues.en: So I'm just going to focus in this video on integrating polynomials.
cues.zh: 所以這段只著重多項式積分。

cues.en: So here is the general formula for the indefinite integral of a polynomial.
cues.zh: 這是多項式不定積分的一般公式。

cues.en: So the integral of B or B is a constant times X, which is the variable and A is some power.
cues.zh: b是常數，乘上變數x的a次方，

cues.en: Also, a constant decs equals B X to the power of A plus one.
cues.zh: a也是常數，再乘dx；積分等於b乘x的a加1次方。

cues.en: And that whole thing divided by eight plus one plus C where C is just some arbitrary constant, might be the number three or minus 10, for example.
cues.zh: 整個再除以a加1，最後加c；c是任意常數，例如3或負10。

cues.en: So how do we make sense of this result and how do we derive this answer from this equation?
cues.zh: 如何理解這個結果，又如何從等式推導這個答案？

cues.en: Well, the way to do that is to think backwards and say what is the derivative of this formula or this expression?
cues.zh: 方法是倒過來想，問這個公式、這個運算式的導數是多少？

cues.en: So the derivative of this expression would be to take this power here, bring it down here, to multiply the B, and then we subtract one from this power.
cues.zh: 求導時，把這個次方拿下來乘b，再把次方減1。

cues.en: So this would end up being A plus one, minus one, which is, of course, a and then we have the eight plus one term out front and that cancels out the eight plus one.
cues.zh: 就成了a加1減1，當然是a；前面還有a加1，會和分母的a加1約掉。

cues.en: So then we end up with B times X to the power of A..
cues.zh: 最後就得到b乘x的a次方。

cues.en: So that's the derivative of this.
cues.zh: 這是這個式子的導數。

cues.en: And now this constant here also comes from taking the derivative of this expression because the derivative of a constant is always zero.
cues.zh: 這個常數，也來自對運算式求導，因為常數的導數永遠是0。

cues.en: Right?
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: A constant is not moving.
cues.zh: 常數不會移動。

cues.en: It's just a straight line.
cues.zh: 就是一條直線。

cues.en: So if it's not changing over time, then its derivative is zero.
cues.zh: 不隨時間改變，所以導數是0。

cues.en: So you could also implicitly write plus zero in here and that wouldn't do anything.
cues.zh: 也可以在這裡隱含寫加0，沒有影響。

cues.en: Now that leaves open the question of why it's the right thing to do to define this integral as being the opposite of the derivative.
cues.zh: 那仍有一個問題：為什麼把積分定義成求導的反運算是對的？

cues.en: And that is one of the most important principles of calculus, which is that integration and derivation are the opposites of each other.
cues.zh: 這是微積分最重要的原理之一，積分與求導互為反運算。

cues.en: And you are going to be able to demonstrate that in the exercise.
cues.zh: 你可以在練習展示它。

cues.en: OK, so this is a formula.
cues.zh: 好，這是公式。

cues.en: Let's go through one simple example.
cues.zh: 看一個簡單例子。

cues.en: So let's say we want to compute the indefinite integral of four times X squared.
cues.zh: 假設要算4乘x平方的不定積分。

cues.en: Well, we just follow this principle here.
cues.zh: 就照這個原則。

cues.en: So that's two plus one.
So X cubed.
cues.zh: 所以是x立方。

cues.en: And then we put the exponent plus one also in the denominator here.
cues.zh: 再把指數加1，也放進分母。

cues.en: And of course, add C and now we can quickly confirm that computing the derivative of this side will give us this term here.
cues.zh: 當然，再加c；可以快速確認，對這邊求導，就得到這一項。

cues.en: So the derivative of this is going to be we take down the three and this becomes 12 times X squared, but then it's divided by three.
cues.zh: 求導時把3拿下來，變成12乘x平方，但再除以3。

cues.en: So that brings this 12 back down to four and that gives us exactly this term in here.
cues.zh: 12就降回4，正好得到這裡的項。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。
